{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured black blouse with a relaxed collar, boxy fit, hip length, #1b1815, crisp cotton poplin.
Dark washed denim jeans with a straight leg, knee length, #2a2f35, sturdy stretch twill.
Black leather ankle boots with a chunky sole and minimal heel, mid-calf height, #0e0c0d, smooth grain leather.
Thin black leather choker necklace and small silver hoop earrings.

This outfit bridges the gap between rock concert energy and smart social appropriateness while respecting the November weather in a club setting. The dark denim provides comfort for walking around the venue without looking sloppy, matching her natural hair color perfectly. The structured black top adds a polished element that elevates the look beyond basic casual wear, suitable for a Friday night out. Finally, the leather ankle boots offer practical warmth and stability on potentially crowded dance floors or wet pavement."}
